bound_failure_signature.interpretation: The v1 interval-JVP machinery fails to prove even one derivative-sign leaf on the frozen d8 NEAR_ZERO cohort. This falsifies the v1 bound implementation as practically vacuous; it does not establish that the underlying field is nonregular.

independent_diagnostic_not_authority.description: Post-run direct autograd sampling on the exact frozen field, 5x5x5 samples per d8 cell, using each cell's center-gradient direction. This diagnostic is not a certificate and was not part of the preregistered run.
independent_diagnostic_not_authority.claim_boundary: This strongly suggests range-tightness loss rather than demonstrated true nonregularity, but it cannot mint C1 certificates.

root_cause_hypothesis: Directional derivative correlation is discarded by interval propagation, especially across LayerNorm.
LayerNorm dmu/dvar products treat strongly correlated primal/tangent quantities independently.
Subsequent SiLU-prime times tangent interval products amplify the resulting over-approximation.

requirements: propagate primal and directional tangent with shared affine generators
use exact affine triplane directional derivative inside each interpolation regime
preserve correlation through LayerNorm via dual-affine products with conservative remainder
preserve tangent correlation through SiLU using bounded derivative factor plus affine product
re-run exact semantic and adversarial fixtures before frozen Knight
